description: After fz-go4.16.9 moves run_root_interp to RootBackendProduct, focused 00181 product proof passes, but broader legacy interp fixtures still expose incomplete product coverage. Repro examples: cargo test -q --lib compiler2::drive_test::compiler2_interp_runs_enum_reduce_while_halt_payload_with_distinct_type -- --exact and cargo test -q --lib compiler2::drive_test::compiler2_interp_runs_spawned_children_from_backend_runtime_intrinsics -- --exact both hit product fact-wait budgets for settled ReturnType. Earlier broad compiler2 filter also showed continuation/resume transport gaps in first-class callable continuation and distinct boxed callable fixtures. Treat these as product coverage work, not reason to stitch the legacy root artifact path back into run_root_interp.
title: Pull interp: close remaining product return-type and continuation coverage
